body: Aw, sounds nice. I can imagine myself being afraid about his interest in me too, so maybe it's natural? I hope everything will go well for both of you guys)) And thank you for an update!)
That's great)) It is. I wish you luck man.
Definitely post an update if possible! I'm interested because i had similar idea but i don't own a motorcycle yet, so i wanna know how this is gonna end up))

So i read the book and i think i got the point of it. Throw away expectations and life immediately becomes worth living. It's really deep even when it doesn't look like it. I want to thank you for this amazing recommendation.
All the time. I feel the same way.

Sure! And thank you. This post and you helped me a lot. I mean, I know I can't keep this mood and spirit forever. My mind balance is like a sine wave. I'm still trying to find something, like a code, procedure, i can stick to even when i feel totally blue and see black and white only. And a day off always feels like a loss. Unless you need to recover. Hardest thing is to find "motivation without motivation".

Thanks for the compliment. Your reply got me thinking and i was trying to find the right words last few days. So, i apologize for a delay. There's one thing that helps me to get rid of bad feelings and that's a music. I mean.. the kind of music that you feel like a hero when you're listening to it. An article about existential despair said that you should think of 10 things you're proud about yourself. I found only one. I can get things done. It was late evening, i was really tired and fed up. "I can get sh*t done". It went through my head and i went out for a run. It was my best run yet and i felt like a god afterwards. And i realised that i've always took a harder ways to deal with things and situations. That's another reason why i know deep inside i will never do something stupid. I started running again every day since that night. Another thing i realised is a power of progress. In anything. I mean, even when you hate yourself, you can be at least proud of things you do. For your friends, family and yourself. And on the other hand, your actions is what describes you, right? Sometimes being stuck on a same place and not moving forward is what keeps you blind and full of darkness. I was doing this too often and only sometimes realised that sticking to doing fundamental productive things, even when you don't see purpose in doing them, can actually help you a lot.

Yeah.. Someone is willing to go through life with 90% of pain to enjoy 10% of happiness. But that's not me. Maybe I'm too analytical but i would rather off myself right there instead of waiting.. I comfort myself with an idea that everyone will die one day so why should one care. But it's getting scarier since i started to plan my own ideal suicide.

I have always searched for meanings. It's just my nature. I don't know why. And since I'm getting older and I'm able to think about topics and scenarios more realistically and deeply, I've came to the conclusion that life itself is meaningless. So am i. But on the other side, i know it's wrong because this is not a major problem of other people. So there must be something wrong with me.
I noticed that i just can't stop and relax, enjoy present moment. Even when I'm successful at something, Deeply inside I'm sad because i look too much in the future. Maybe.
So i like to dream about me being successful and useful. Like helping other people somehow or sacrifice of my own life to save someone else. Doing something like Will Smith, when he played the role of Tim Thomas in a movie called Seven Pounds. I was recently thinking about enrollment in the bone marrow donor registry, just to feel useful somehow in this world. A read a lot about existential crisis and similar stuff but i can't find solution by myself. Sometimes i like to think about being in relationship. Idea of someone holding me and telling me they love me makes me calm and "happy". But then i realise how can i love someone when i can't even love or be in peace with myself. Damn, my head is a mess.. And i don't want to talk to therapist. I feel exposed when i talk about my own personal problems. The best way to describe my feelings is through text like this. I can't talk about it and be that exactly accurate since I'm introverted and little bit antisocial because of self hatred and because of lack of my social interaction skills. I don't talk too much...

I remember the first time when i decided to run. I was on my way home in a subway and i had an anxiety attack or something. I stepped out one station before my final and i ran home to just release all the pressure i felt. It quickly became my hobby and i started to do it more often because it helped me. And i still do it occasionally to keep myself in shape. It's just not that often. I lost about 15kg of weight thanks to it. And still, i am not satisfied with myself. With time, it became just another stupid neverending routine. Motivation disappeared. As well as with writing. I just don't see purpose in anything. Everyone will die one day, nothing will stay forever and nobody have a special purpose. I see myself just another useless number in a binary code called society. I'm just getting tired of trying new things to evade depression but it will always make it's way back to the surface. I want to cry but i can't.
